gsave.config.generic.comment.enabled: When disabled, no snapshots are created and no safety snapshot is taken before restoring.
gsave.config.generic.comment.scheduledSn: Create snapshots at the configured interval. Disabled by default.
gsave.config.generic.comment.baselineSna: Create a baseline snapshot about 5 seconds after entering a world.
gsave.config.generic.comment.disconnectS: Create a "world disconnect" snapshot when leaving a singleplayer world. It contains no screenshot.
gsave.config.generic.comment.autoSnapsho: Interval between scheduled snapshots, 1 to 1440 minutes, default 15. Only shown when scheduled snapshots are enabled.
gsave.config.generic.comment.scheduledSn: Disable scheduled snapshots once the snapshot count reaches this value; 0 means never auto-disable.
gsave.config.generic.comment.maxSnapshot: Oldest snapshots are cleaned up beyond this count. Default 50.
gsave.config.generic.comment.unlimitedSn: When enabled, old snapshots are never removed automatically. Disk usage will keep growing.
gsave.config.generic.comment.snapshotPri: Favor gameplay: snapshots run on a background thread so the game and redstone keep running (default). Favor save speed: runs on the server thread, faster but may stutter briefly.
gsave.config.generic.comment.snapshotReg: Include region/*.mca terrain chunks in snapshots.
gsave.config.generic.comment.snapshotEnt: Include entities/*.mca entity chunks in snapshots.
gsave.config.generic.comment.snapshotPoi: Include poi/*.mca point-of-interest chunks in snapshots.
gsave.config.generic.comment.snapshotLev: Include the world metadata file level.dat in snapshots.
gsave.config.generic.comment.snapshotPla: Include playerdata/*.dat player data in snapshots.
gsave.config.generic.comment.skipUnchang: Automatic snapshots are skipped when the world is identical to the previous snapshot. Manual snapshots are unaffected.
gsave.config.generic.comment.protectManu: When enabled, manual snapshots are never removed by the max snapshot count. Pinned snapshots are always kept.
